page: Microsoft Azure E32ads_v6 is a memory-optimized virtual machine powered by an AMD EPYC 9V74 x86_64 processor clocked at 3.7 GHz. Managed under Microsoft Hyper-V, the instance is provisioned with 16 physical cores and 32 dedicated vCPUs with hyper-threading enabled. Cache allocation consists of 32 KB L1d cache, 1.0 MB L2 cache, and 32 MB L3 cache. It incorporates 256.0 GB of system RAM, maintaining an 8.0 GB memory-to-vCPU ratio. Local ephemeral storage is bundled as 1890 GB of high-speed NVMe SSD capacity, while no dedicated hardware GPU accelerators are present.

Benchmark outcomes demonstrate robust compute throughput and high memory speed. Geekbench evaluates single-core performance at 1,980.0 points and multi-core at 16,104.0 points, placing both in the top 25% bracket. Similarly, stress-ng yields 3,079.96 in single-core CPU testing and 49,283.7 in multi-core metrics. PassMark highlights strong memory capability with a score of 2,758.74, accompanied by an encryption score of 38,619.67 boosted by hardware AES, VAES, and SHA-NI flags. Memory bandwidth registers at 2,433.15 GB/sec for small cached blocks, 75.65 GB/sec for uncached read-only blocks, and 55.63 GB/sec for writes. In-memory data handling through Redis measures 44.75 million SET operations per second.

The CPU includes broad AVX instructions, featuring AVX-512F, AVX-512 VNNI, and AVX-512 BF16. Lightweight model execution performs well on this architecture, delivering 2,755.25 prompt processing tokens per second and 341.89 text generation tokens per second for a 135M model (top 10%). However, performance tapers as model size scales without discrete accelerators: medium (7B) inference registers 90.46 prompt tokens per second and 17.42 generation tokens per second, while 70B models drop to 8.7 prompt tokens per second.

Azure E32ads_v6 provides balanced cost efficiency for memory-heavy and disk-intensive deployments by combining substantial RAM with 1,890 GB of local NVMe storage on a single virtual host. It is structurally aligned with in-memory caching layers, enterprise relational databases, large-scale data transformation (ETL), and compressed analytics pipelines.
description: Microsoft Azure E32ads_v6 is a memory-optimized virtual machine featuring a 3.7 GHz AMD EPYC 9V74 processor with 16 physical cores and 32 dedicated vCPUs. The instance supplies 256.0 GB of RAM (8.0 GB per vCPU) and includes 1890 GB of local NVMe SSD storage without integrated GPUs. Evaluated benchmarks show strong single-core CPU execution with a Geekbench score of 1,980.0 and PassMark memory performance of 2,758.74. Uncached memory throughput reaches 75.65 GB/sec for reads and 55.63 GB/sec for writes, alongside Redis handling of 44.75 million SET operations per second. Modern AVX-512 instructions enable rapid vector computation, achieving 341.89 tokens per second for small LLM text generation. Designed for memory-intensive architectures, the E32ads_v6 is best suited for production in-memory databases, caching nodes, big data processing, and enterprise application hosting.
